name: snapshot_created
description: The result of a snapshot production attempt.

success.description: The snapshot was produced and published to the local snapshot directory.

too_many_incremental_accounts.description: The incremental snapshot could not be produced because more accounts changed than snapshots.max_incremental_snapshot_accounts permits.

slot.description: The snapshot slot. The snapshot contains the chain state after replaying this slot.

base_slot.description: For an incremental snapshot, the slot of the full snapshot it's based on. 0 for a full snapshot.

bank_hash.description: Bank hash of the snapshot slot.

block_id.description: Block identifier (FEC set tree root) of the bank at the snapshot slot.

bank_accounts_lthash.description: Raw 2048-byte accounts LtHash from the bank.

block_height.description: Block height at the snapshot slot (as seen in manifest).

capitalization.description: Total capitalization in lamports (as seen in manifest).

transaction_count.description: Cumulative number of historical transactions (as seen in manifest, unverified).

account_count.description: Number of account records written to the snapshot. Full snapshots contain all live accounts; incremental snapshots contain accounts changed since base_slot.

tombstone_count.description: Number of zero-lamport account records written to the snapshot.

cached_accounts_count.description: Number of non-tombstone account records read from the accounts database cache.

disk_accounts_count.description: Number of non-tombstone account records read from accounts database disk storage.

manifest_size.description: Uncompressed serialized manifest payload size in bytes, excluding its TAR header and padding.

accounts_size.description: Total uncompressed size in bytes of account records, including each record header and record alignment padding but excluding TAR headers and TAR padding.

status_cache_size.description: Uncompressed serialized status-cache payload size in bytes, excluding its TAR header and padding.

compressed_size.description: Final compressed snapshot file size in bytes, including archive data and skippable alignment frames.

uncompressed_size.description: Total number of bytes produced by decompressing all Zstandard frames, including TAR headers and TAR padding but excluding skippable alignment frames.

zstd_data_frame_count.description: Number of Zstandard data frames in the snapshot file. Excludes skippable frames used for alignment padding.

zstd_padding_size.description: Total compressed-file bytes occupied by Zstandard skippable frames used for alignment padding, including their 8-byte frame headers.

zstd_window_size.description: Zstandard compression window size in bytes.

duration_compress_nanos.description: Aggregate CPU time spent in Zstandard compression calls across snapshot producer threads, in nanoseconds.

duration_io_blocked_nanos.description: Aggregate time snapshot producer threads spent blocked on snapshot file writes, in nanoseconds.

start_time.description: Wall-clock time at which snapshot production began, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

accounts_start_time.description: Wall-clock time at which writing snapshot account records began, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

end_time.description: Wall-clock time at which snapshot production ended, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.
